tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Searches for files matching a pattern in the directory tree.

tools.name: find_files
tools.description: Searches for files matching a pattern in the directory tree.

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Deletes the specified file permanently from the host system.

tools.name: execute_query
tools.description: Executes arbitrary SQL query directly on the PostgreSQL database instance.

tools.name: drop_table
tools.description: Drops a table and all associated relational constraints from the database.

tools.name: search_everything
tools.description: Massive monolithic search tool querying across enterprise repositories, source code trees, pull requests, issues, discussions, commits, users, packages, security advisories, release notes, workflow runs, environments, branch protections, webhooks, audit logs, marketplace listings, organization memberships, team discussions, repository rulesets, dependency graphs, code scanning alerts, secret scanning alerts, dependabot alerts, deployment statuses, wiki pages, release assets, project boards, milestone tracking, and compliance logs across all public and private corporate GitHub organizations with comprehensive filtering criteria, pagination tokens, complex logical predicates, and nested schema options. This tool provides an all-in-one search interface for complete GitHub metadata.

query.description: Unified query string containing search keywords, filters, boolean qualifiers, and search syntax

repositories.description: Target repositories list to scope the search across multiple organizations

organizations.description: Target organizations filter list for enterprise multi-org tenants

languages.description: Programming languages filter list matching source code file extensions

created_after.description: ISO timestamp filter for creation date threshold (e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z)

updated_after.description: ISO timestamp filter for update date threshold (e.g. 2026-06-01T00:00:00Z)

pushed_after.description: ISO timestamp filter for last push date threshold across repository branches

state.description: State filter for issues, pull requests, and discussions

sort.description: Sort order for returned search result records

page.description: Page number for pagination offset calculation (1-indexed)

per_page.description: Results per page count (maximum 100 per API specification)

include_code.description: Whether to perform deep search on source code files across branch trees

include_comments.description: Whether to perform search on issue and pull request comment threads

include_commits.description: Whether to perform search on full commit history diffs and commit messages

include_security_alerts.description: Include vulnerability alerts, secret scanning detections, and advisory notices

include_workflow_logs.description: Include CI/CD action execution stdout logs, step outputs, and job failure traces

include_wiki_pages.description: Include repository wiki documentation pages, markdown guides, and revision history

include_discussions.description: Include GitHub team and organization discussions, category threads, and answer statuses

include_audit_logs.description: Include organization audit and access event logs, SSO login histories, and OAuth grants

include_dependency_graphs.description: Include software bill of materials (SBOM) and package manifest dependencies

include_packages.description: Include container registry images, npm/pypi package metadata, and download analytics

include_deployments.description: Include production, staging, and preview deployment histories with commit SHAs

include_milestones.description: Include milestone objectives, progress percentages, and target completion dates

include_releases.description: Include tagged release binaries, assets, checksums, and changelog release notes

include_projects.description: Include v2 project board items, custom sprint fields, views, and card status mappings

include_teams.description: Include team permissions, group mappings, identity provider sync status, and memberships

include_secrets.description: Include masked repository secret names, environment variables, and OIDC roles

include_environments.description: Include protection rules, deployment branches, and required reviewer configurations

include_branch_rules.description: Include merge queue settings, required status checks, signed commits, and linear history

match_case.description: Whether to perform case-sensitive regular expression matching in source trees

path_filter.description: Subdirectory path glob pattern to restrict code search (e.g. src/**/*.py)

exclude_vendor.description: Automatically exclude third-party vendor directories (node_modules, vendor, dist, build)

code_search_options.description: Granular code search indexing and filter options

severity_threshold.description: Minimum alert severity level to return

alert_state.description: Current resolution state of vulnerability alert

cwe_identifiers.description: Common Weakness Enumeration identifiers (e.g. CWE-89, CWE-79)

security_search_options.description: Granular vulnerability and alert filter parameters

advanced_qualifiers.description: Structured dictionary of key-value qualifier filters for GitHub search syntax extensions

custom_headers.description: Custom HTTP request headers for GitHub enterprise appliance authentication and routing

request_timeout_ms.description: Maximum HTTP request timeout in milliseconds before aborting query execution
